reproduction: Boot the local 0.23.0 ZIP with fresh disposable UEFI/USB media; create an owner account and enable 2FA.
Switch to the actual guest TTY2 using Ctrl+Alt+F2. A wrong password must return to the administrator prompt without offering recovery.
A correct password must request the second factor; an invalid factor must return to the login prompt. systemd clears the terminal on command exit.
Authenticate with the owner password and a single-use recovery code. Select DHCP on one port and choose the connected emulated NIC.
Before confirming locally, use the authenticated API to trial a management address outside the QEMU user network; verify HTTPS is unreachable.
Confirm YES on TTY2 before the two-minute automatic trial rollback. HTTPS health must return, titand must be running, pending must be empty and the selected NIC must use legacy DHCP configuration.
limits: No real console, keyboard, NIC, switch or production data was used.
The other recovery-menu path and additional console/input variants were not exercised in this interactive test.
